messages:
Sam T.: We have a DSAR delete for acct-5544 but the deletion receipt is missing the structured audit snippet. eraser job shows success but no Cloud Audit Logs entry for storage.delete in that window :confused:
Lina V.: Missing app-level audit could be RBAC or sink issue. Which SA ran the job?
Sam T.: erasure@redwood svc acct. Trace shows job-id eraser-2026-03-20-xx; time 03:16-03:18 UTC. No storage.delete protoPayload in audit export for that run
Omar N.: I see an IAM change yesterday: ops-deploy removed roles/logging.logWriter from erasure@redwood during RBAC cleanup. That would prevent the app from writing structured logs to Stackdriver
Priya R.: Cloud Audit Logs should still capture admin-level activity, but application JSONPayload entries rely on logWriter. Check sink health and whether the SA can write to the audit bucket
AuditBot: iam:policy_update actor=ops-deploy change=removed role=roles/logging.logWriter member=serviceAccount:erasure@redwood
Anya (Legal): For GDPR we need proof of deletion or a retention-exception. If deletion happened but logs missing, collect alternate evidence: storage object versions/generations, job trace, KMS decrypt calls, container stdout, and OpsBot events
Sam T.: Proposed immediate actions: pause erasure queue for ephemeral tenants; regrant minimal logging role; run a read-only proof-replay that references original run id to generate a canonical receipt; collect KMS logs; compile audit bundle
Lina V.: Paused ephemeral queue: ./scripts/erasure pause --queue ephemeral. Opening incident PRV-5012 to track.
Omar N.: Re-granting now: gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod --member=serviceAccount:erasure@redwood --role=roles/logging.logWriter
AuditBot: policy_update actor=ops-deploy role_added=roles/logging.logWriter member=serviceAccount:erasure@redwood
Priya R.: I'll collect alternate evidence into gs://redwood-privacy/audit-bundles/PRV-5012/: gsutil ls -L, job traces, and KMS decrypt history. Example: gcloud logging read 'jsonPayload.jobId="eraser-2026-03-20"' --project=redwood-prod > /tmp/eraser-trace.json
Lina V.: Runbook change: add `erasure:proof-replay` step and require SA logging permission pre-deploy. Filing PRV-5013 for runbook updates
Anya (Legal): Once bundle is ready I'll review and advise on retention-exception vs reconstructed proof. If exception needed, must include approvals and a customer comms template
Sam T.: Created PRV-5012 and SEC-2098 to harden RBAC for erasure SA. Lina will own audit bundle. ETA EOD
Lina V.: Will produce bundle and runbook patch. If we need to reply to requester, Legal will draft language.
Sam T.: Notifying Support to mark DSAR as "in progress - evidence gathering" and update requester. Closing updates will live in PRV-5012 thread :white_check_mark:
